analysis:
The diff to docs/reference/configuration.md is documentation-only. At head lines 5-7 it changes the intro text, replacing 'retained-console' with provider CLI and native-runtime scope and adding 'console' to the platform-owned settings pointer. At base lines 81-99 it removes the 'Console UI' section, which listed NEXT_PUBLIC_* build-time variables for the retained console. That removal is consistent with the threat model's out_of_scope list, which already places the consumer console and admin UI outside this repo's scope. No code, control, default or environment-variable behavior changes.

The supplied base units (lines 486-753) are surrounding context outside the changed ranges. They document the prefix-cache, SSD cache storage, memory and attestation-adjacent controls (T-041, TB-007), such as DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE, TTL <=1800 and cache.directory/volume_uuid. None of it is modified, so there is no regression in those controls. I did not verify that the documented defaults match source; that is pre-existing and outside this PR.

The removed Console UI section could not be fully inspected because the patch excerpt is truncated. A residual question for integration is whether the console-ui code and its secrets guidance (never put private credentials in NEXT_PUBLIC_*) were removed or relocated elsewhere in the PR. That would only be a documentation or scope concern, not a provider threat-model regression.
